description: This Java class 'Content' is a JPA entity representing content data within a sales management system. It includes mappings to database columns, relationships to descriptions and merchant store, and fields for content attributes such as code, visibility, position, type, and order.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a content item, with properties for descriptions, merchant store association, code, visibility, position, type, and order. It includes mappings for database persistence and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the content.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the content with a merchant store.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the content is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the content.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order for the content.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the content.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the first description if available, else null.
